Question: Which delivery costs more, vaginal or C-section?
Answer: I charge the same amount as professional fees even if it is vaginal delivery or c section. Reason: I believe that there should be no financial incentive to the obstetrician , to prefer a certain mode of delivery. Now let me talk about world Wide scenario: In most countries, vaginal deliveries are conducted by midwives. The obstetrician is not supposed to even attend. Naturally the costs for vaginal delivery will be less. In india, we donot accept midwife for delivery. We want a doctor , that too a specialist for delivery. So costs should go high. Actually, operative vaginal delivery by application of forceps or vaccum is much more skillful and ideally should have higher cost. Yet in many places vaginal delivery ( even if attended by a specialist doctor is inadequately renumerated as against C section, even by insurance companies.

Question: If you have had unprotected sex the night before the abortion, can you still be pregnant after the abortion?
Answer: It is an interesting question. And the answer to the question is NO. How does woman become pregnant? The egg is released by the ovary. The sperms enter the uterus and reach out to the egg and fertilise it. These sperms can stay active for maximum 2 days. The fertilised egg settles inside the uterus which already has developed a lining to host this embyo. ( Source: Google) What is the effect of pregnancy? Once the woman is already pregnant, the mouth of the uterus gets blocked and does not allow entry of sperm. There is no ovulation or fresh egg generation. How does the process of abortion impact? It will take few days for ovulation to resume after few days post abortion. Till then the sperm will not stay alive. During the process of abortion , the lining of uterus is scraped as well. It will take few days for it to form and support pregnancy. For above reasons , one can not become pregnant due to intercourse done a day prior to abortion. Mind you intercourse done few days later can lead to pregnancy. This it is advisable to use contraceptive .

Question: What if non-pregnant women take Misoprostol?
Answer: At first thanks for this interesting question. It just depicts how human mind thinks and works.. In a non pregnant state if misoprostol is used then it will not cause any great health risk per say. The person may experience common side effects such as nausea, shivering, feverishness, diarrhoea and colicky abdominal pain. Allergic reactions are very rare. Misoprostol causes softening of the cervix and causes contractions of the uterus. Due to this property , it is used commonly on non pregnant uterus before surgeries like hysteroscopy and on DNC.

Question: Is it unethical to abort a baby if they will be born heavily disabled?
Answer: Ethics and morals are individualistic. Those who believe in pro life ideology will not believe in abortion irrespective of the condition. Most people are practical. A baby born with substantially serious abnormalities may have poor quality of life and intolerable suffering too. And parents of such child may also suffer while raising the child. Hence they may want to consider abortion. I believe that the pregnant woman alone should have the right to decide. What is important here is what does the law say? Is it illegal to abort such a pregnancy? Indian Medical termination Act allows termination of pregnancy till 20 weeks when there are major abnormalities . I have been for the change in the law and I expect that the same would happen in near future.
